note: Report-only lints. Every SURFACE-* and RESPONSIVE-* rule is forward_test_required: it stays a reported observation with autofix false until the candidate rule passes production desktop AND mobile Preview forward tests. Surface comparisons use RESOLVED outer bounds (x position + width after padding and nested columns), never raw width equality - two parts can share a raw width and still misalign when their insets differ.

rules.assertion: readiness == ready && no unresolved item has canChangeMutation == true
rules.failureMessage: Mutation started before the evidence gate closed.

rules.assertion: at each breakpoint, every part's resolved outer bounds (left edge and right edge) equal the surface's outer bounds
rules.failureMessage: A continuous surface changes resolved outer bounds at its seam.

rules.assertion: internal corners between parts have zero radius; only the outer perimeter carries radii
rules.failureMessage: A continuous surface has an internal corner radius (notch/crescent seam).

rules.assertion: one responsive content tree expresses both breakpoints (paired-section escape hatch remains valid where recomposition genuinely differs)
rules.failureMessage: Duplicate per-breakpoint trees where supported controls could express one.
